data_access_order: The Q90 artifact had already been computed and its summary inspected before this A27 audit was specified. This is not a preregistration or confirmatory test.
objective: Describe full-catalog formula-rank stability across chronological splits and the retrospective oracle-best formula/family lifecycle for each target. Do not claim ex-ante predictive skill.

analysis.family_winner_rule: For each target, select the family-specific retrospective best formula by highest number_hits_top5, then lowest rank_sum, then lexical family tag.
analysis.family_sequence_null: 20,000 random permutations preserving observed family-winner counts; descriptive exchangeability reference only.

limitations: The Q90 universe is finite and conditional on 20 Discovery-selected features from a 59-feature matrix; it is not all 59-feature combinations or all mathematical formulas.
The Q90 source archive ends 2026-11-07 and is older than the canonical archive through 2026-11-13.
The historical Blind OOS has already been exposed to prior SONAR research.
The target ledger stores the per-target oracle-best formula and seven family-specific oracle bests, not the full 330,429-by-target rank tensor.
Formula IDs are strongly dependent because their feature sets overlap; cross-formula rank correlations and top-set overlap are descriptive, not independent-sample inferential tests.
The oracle formula/family labels use the target outcome and cannot be used to forecast that same target.
